note: Provincial recreation-area campground 30 km west of Rocky Mountain House on Hwy 11, run by Westward Bound Campgrounds with a camp host on site. Treed loops north of Chambers Creek, a cook shelter and a group site. Firewood sold by the caretaker. No ATV use in the campground. --Claude
summary: Read the Alberta Parks page (updated Aug 6, 2026) and Westward Bound's page: 25 unserviced self-registration sites C$28 (cash/cheque), max stay 16 nights, season May 8 - Oct 4 (derived approximate -> exact), pump water not potable, outhouses. Phone suggested. OHV-trails wording reported. Pin OK.
